serverInfo.title: Pipefire email deliverability tools
serverInfo.description: Pipefire (pipefire.ai) is cold email software for agencies that sets up and runs outreach for you: it buys and warms the sending domains and mailboxes, finds and verifies prospects, writes the emails for you to approve, and sorts the replies. This server gives any assistant 16 free email deliverability tools (SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MX, BIMI and MTA-STS checks, blacklist lookups, email header analysis, cold email and subject line scoring, DNS record generators). Pipefire customers who sign in can also read their campaigns, replies, mailboxes and results, draft new campaigns and pause or resume sending from the chat.
